# One Click KB Switch {{version}}

## Highlights
- Windows x64 installer release
- Native tray + keyboard layout switching
- Default single-click switching for RightCtrl / RightShift
- Custom combo hotkeys via tray capture flow

## Known limitations
- Windows low-level hooks are implemented, but final release quality still depends on manual QA across multiple foreground applications and IME scenarios.
- Code signing is intentionally postponed for v1.
